widgets_values: claymation style. A cinematic continuous video showing a woman while the video is changing the style in the middle. consistent outfit, natural camera motion, coherent lighting, realistic motion, stable temporal consistency.

1: A realistic adult woman stands centered on a softly lit city street at dusk, shown in a stable medium shot. She holds a clean cardboard sign reading "Time-Gated LoRA" clearly toward the camera with both hands. The same outfit, same background, and same framing remain consistent. She looks at the camera, then slowly raises the sign until the entire frame is fully covered by the plain back side of the cardboard, completely blocking the view of her face and body. | 2: claymation style, stop motion clay, handcrafted clay character, miniature clay diorama, visible clay texture, fingerprints in clay, soft sculpted forms. The cardboard lowers and moves fully out of frame, revealing the same woman and the same street now transformed into a clear claymation world. Her face, hair, jacket, shirt, jeans, and the street environment all appear sculpted from clay. She remains mostly still, gently breathing and making only small natural movements, holding the claymation appearance clearly for a moment. No readable text is visible in this segment. | 3: The plain blank back side of the same board, with no text, no letters, no writing, and no symbols, slowly rises close to the camera until it fully covers the frame. It then lowers out of view, revealing the same woman again in the original realistic photographic scene, with natural skin, realistic clothing, and the same dusk city street background. She gives a small relaxed smile and holds the restored realistic appearance clearly for a moment while the camera framing remains stable.
